@copilot Update this PR directly with a narrow cleanup. In `testing/testing-common/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/junit/MessagingMetricsAssertions.java`, restore the original `verifyHistogram` implementation from this PR's merge base: assert count `1` for every histogram point, extract the attributes, and use `containsExactlyInAnyOrder(attributes)`. Remove the added empty-case branch and the loop that builds per-point consumers. The old assertion preserves the empty expectation's behavior without special handling, so don't add a type check or replace it with another fluent variant.

Delete the newly added `testing/testing-common/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/junit/MessagingMetricsAssertionsTest.java` fixture from this PR and remove imports made unused by these two changes. Keep the fluent `verifyCounter` assertion and the existing module test conversions unchanged. Run the focused `testing-common` validation that covers the helper. Keep the existing draft PR and don't create another PR.

replies.body: Restored the merge-base histogram assertion, removed the fixture, and retained the fluent counter assertion. `:testing:testing-common:test` passes. Commit: `a5597ed8`.
